cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says how many refugees were issued identity documents; 9,625 Burkinabes were biometrically registered in 2025, with no documents stated.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-15: the refugee Ghana Card exercise reached two more regions in March 2026 and the refugee board got ID production equipment in August 2026, but no number of documents issued is held. Refugees may register SIMs with their refugee ID, but each step must be shown in turn, so stage 2.
